summary: 复核了 CRLF 空行修正：label loop 现在将 CRLF 空行识别为段落边界，新增断言覆盖原失败输入；该项已解决。其余前轮已核对的 escaped opener、LF 软换行、嵌套图片及引用链接结果保持不变。

findings.marked_4_3_0_lexer: Two paragraphs separated by a blank line; no link token.
findings.impact: The new label scan only recognizes LF blank lines with `[ \t]*\n`; CRLF blank lines are crossed as if they were soft line breaks, so scan() can report a literal Markdown span as an active javascript link. The old single-line regex did not match this span, so this is a new false positive.

scripts/wiki.py 使用 r"[ 	]*?
" 识别 LF/CRLF 空行边界；tests/test_wiki.py 在软换行测试中加入 CRLF 空段落断言。复测 [example

text](javascript:alert(1)) 返回空链接集，与 Marked 的段落切分一致。
